profile.name: KiSuk Nam
profile.bio_ko: GNS3 / Cisco IOS 기반 네트워크 실습 → Linux · Docker · K8s · Cloud 로 확장 중. Learning by building & breaking.
profile.bio_en: Hands-on labs with GNS3 / Cisco IOS, expanding into Linux, Docker, K8s and Cloud. Learning by building & breaking.

extra_projects.summary_ko: HQ/DC/BR1/BR2 4개 사이트를 ISP 이중화(eBGP)와 DMVPN Phase3(mGRE over IPsec)으로 연결. DC는 Arista cEOS, 나머지는 Cisco. HSRP/VARP, QoS, 화이트리스트 ACL, 장애 실측까지 GNS3로 구현.
extra_projects.summary_en: Four sites (HQ/DC/BR1/BR2) joined by dual-ISP eBGP and DMVPN Phase 3 (mGRE over IPsec). Arista cEOS in the DC, Cisco elsewhere. HSRP/VARP, QoS, whitelist ACLs and failover tests built in GNS3.
